name: Qinghai Hoh Xil
description: Qinghai Hoh Xil sits on the northeastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau in China, a vast stretch of alpine mountains and open steppe more than 4,500 metres above sea level. Temperatures average below freezing all year. This harsh landscape shelters plants and grazing animals found nowhere else, and it protects the entire migration route of the endangered Tibetan antelope.
